message.content:
**Columbia University** is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College by royal charter of King George II of Great Britain, making it the fifth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States. The university moved to its current Morningside Heights campus in Manhattan in 1897.

Key facts:

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City, NY |
| **Founded** | 1754 (as King's College) |
| **Type** | Private research university |
| **Ivy League member** | Yes |
| **Campus** | Urban, 36 acres |
| **Student body** | ~30,000 (undergraduate, graduate, professional) |
| **Notable schools** | Columbia College (undergraduate), Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, Columbia School of Engineering & Applied Science, Columbia School of Journalism, Columbia School of Architecture, Columbia School of the Arts, Columbia School of International and Public Affairs, etc. |
| **Endowment** | Over $10 billion (as of 2023) |
| **Mascot** | Columbia Lion (though the university has no official mascot; the lion is a common symbol) |
| **Colors** | Columbia Blue and White |
| **Athletics** | NCAA Division I, Big East Conference (men’s basketball, soccer, etc.) |

Columbia is renowned for its rigorous academic programs, distinguished faculty, and contributions to research across disciplines. It has produced numerous Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and leaders in politics, business, and the arts. The university’s flagship building, Low Memorial Library, is an iconic landmark on its campus.
